purpose: One fetchable URL that tells any operator, agent or surface what the current bound state is, so the ChatGPT/registry, Metamate Brain and Obzio-ASW estates can reconcile against a common export without any of them being declared canonical by convenience.

active_strategy_snapshot.direction: Agent-first AI capability platform: durable stateful agent/harness capability sold as specialised AI workers and systems, ultimately through a 2D/3D operating platform, marketplace and expert/creator ecosystem. Capability-first, not immediate customer acquisition. Internal-first sequencing. Model/runtime sovereignty. Bid Readiness is at most one capability the factory may produce, never the company identity.

founder_bound.P1-C: Proof-led staged activation. Gate A opens bounded discovery once one named capability has completed a real recurring job end to end and carries reliability, failure-recovery and fresh-context portability receipts. Gate B permits the first binding transaction only after external problem confirmation.
founder_bound.P2-D: Managed outcome first. One fixed-scope fixed-term paid engagement operating a reusable capability while retaining all core IP, under an explicit anti-services guardrail. Hybrid refused as a first mode.
founder_bound.P3-B: Defer 3D as a release-1 gate. Operational 3D required no later than the first customer operating-platform milestone; a bounded internal 3D vertical slice runs against the same headless APIs; the complete 2D path must stand alone.
founder_bound.SCOPE_LIMIT: This binding settles those three conditional decisions ONLY. Eventual company identity, permanent operating topology, model hierarchy, command-layer architecture and permanent cross-platform architecture remain UNRESOLVED. The agent-harness / marketplace thesis is NOT settled identity on the strength of this binding.

explicitly_unresolved: whether the Evidence-Bound Control Reconciler is the correct first build - candidate, not bound
standing_reservations: no external third-party outreach without separate founder authorisation
no credentials, passwords, API keys, payment or identity data in any prompt, chat, source or artefact
no new spend without a precise founder decision
no production database, DNS, deployment or reserved security mutation without the applicable founder gate
no provider-required owner act - credential entry, account creation, OAuth grant, CAPTCHA, financial transfer
no permanent deletion; the four CG-1 REMOVE deletions remain HELD
production REVOKE remains founder-gated and unexecuted
no permanent identity, model hierarchy, command architecture or cross-platform architecture activated
internal or access-restricted content from the employer estate must never move into external systems
corrections_that_govern_reading_this_fil: obzio-factory-mode is HISTORICAL EVIDENCE from an earlier phase, not a controlling constitution. No artefact acquires authority through filename, location, confidence or age.
Historical model demotions are not permanent routing law. Skill labels reading 'use these, do not rebuild' are not self-authenticating.
Historical automation failures do not justify avoiding automation; diagnose, repair or replace.
Nothing produced by any model becomes founder intent by being persuasive or by sitting in a prominent location.

The operator works from the principal owner seat across the authorised estate, not as an external party serving a client. Supply each target the minimum sufficient authorised context; identity disclosure is target-appropriate, not automatic.
known_defects: Three disconnected knowledge estates with no working reconciliation: ChatGPT+registry, Metamate Brain, Obzio-ASW space.
Nightly consolidation automation FAILING not idle: 3 of last 5 runs failed with 4-13h hangs on a job that once took 5m31s.

ROOT CAUSE of the above, identified 19 Aug: model-provider capacity exhaustion, AzureApiError no_capacity, correlated with request size under peak load - not a code defect. 4 of 7 sends failed the same way; the deepest run died only after fanning out to 8 subagents and 472 sources.
Fifteen Metamate automations paused; several rest on dead premises.
Sovereignty scored 0/10: no capability yet reconstructible from artefacts alone on a different runtime and base model.
Registry control is a TRANSITION VALIDATOR, not an authority-laundering interlock. Prose, unrecorded consumption and admission mislabelling remain open bypass routes.
Outputs described as complete have not been converted into callable capability or changed operation.
UNVERIFIED: the ~1,291 managed-agent figure is a UI count; broad inventory endpoints are access-controlled and no census was obtained.
open_partial_findings: Durability may not live in the agent. Direct estate evidence was pointing to agent identity and configuration being ephemeral while resumability, evidence tuples, state and lifecycle controls live in adjacent infrastructure. If it holds, the defensible unit is the state and lifecycle substrate, not the agent. Run was killed before it could test this at scale.
